name: RushPoint Field Game
_comment: Single source of truth for `npm run play:twa:init` (Bubblewrap). host/startUrl/iconUrl/webManifestUrl MUST match the deployed play-web origin — https://rushpoint-play.web.app by default (see DEPLOY.md). If a custom domain (e.g. play.rushpoint.app) is configured, update every URL here AND deploy the generated /.well-known/assetlinks.json at that origin. Colors mirror apps/play-web/public/manifest.webmanifest. The signingKey keystore (android.keystore, alias `rushpoint`) is generated locally and is gitignored — see PLAY_STORE.md.
